blockers: Decide on cross-encoder vs hybrid reranker
notes: Summary: Oakmere is a mid-enterprise provider of support automation that wants to reduce live-agent load via RAG-based ticket deflection.
Main constraints: very tight latency SLOs for deflection UI (p95 end-to-end target 300-350ms), reranking must produce top-5 precision high enough to keep deflection NPS neutral.
Scale: pilot indexes ~15M historical tickets + 1.2M KB docs, expect production to reach 50M+ vectors; storage and shard planning flagged as priority.
Embedding preferences: prefer 1K-d float or 768-d quantized 8-bit to balance cost vs accuracy; want Redwood Optimize recommendations for quantization profiles.

Reranking: exploring cross-encoder for top-5 re-score (client comment: "If we can't hit p95 <200ms on rerank we can't use it"), also evaluating hybrid approach (sparse+dense filter then cross-encoder top-k=50 -> top5).
Cost targets: aiming for <$0.005 cost per user query at 95th percentile in steady state; POC must include cost simulation (100k queries) and tokenized spend projection.
Security/compliance: SOC2 in progress, require SSO (SAML), audit logging, KMS integration for keys, and option to enforce EU data residency for EU customers (multi-region routing).
Operational needs: auto-refresh for embeddings on edits, incremental indexing for new tickets (near-real-time), TTL for obsolete content, easy rollback of reranker models via rollout policies.
Quote from Head of ML (Evan Mirza): "We need deterministic latency & predictable unit economics — show us measurable cost per query and p95 latency with 15M index before we expand."
AE notes: strong interest in Dedicated for predictable throughput, but wants to see hosted + Optimize recommendations first. Prefers a short Dedicated pilot (1-2 months) if POC meets SLOs.
SE notes: suggest testing prefix/KV cache for common flows and a small on-node cross-encoder to meet rerank SLOs; recommended batch size tuning and quantization guidance from Redwood Optimize.
Customer asked for: example telemetry dashboard per-route, per-token cost breakdown, and a sample canary rollout plan for reranker changes.
Risk: legal flagged EU residency for EU accounts; procurement timeline depends on that sign-off.
Shortlist of success criteria for POC: ingest 15M docs, achieve end-to-end p95 <=350ms, rerank p95 <=200ms for top-5, cost per query projection below target, security checklist pass.
